questions.question: Yog Sunder Desai, a pioneer who ventured into the world of Indian Dance in the pre-independence era, was born on July 16, 1921 in __________.
questions.solution: Yog Sunder Desai, a pioneering figure in Indian dance who founded the Indian Revivalist Group in 1948, was born in Gujarat. He was instrumental in blending classical techniques with folk traditions to create a unique nationalistic dance language during the independence era.

questions.question: ____________ along with his wife, herself a dancer, and their son built Srjan in 1993.
questions.solution:
Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra, along with his wife Laxmipriya Mohapatra and their son Ratikant Mohapatra, founded the premier Odissi institution Srjan (Srujan) in 1993.

Note: The name 'Srjan' stands for Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi Nrityaabasa and is dedicated to the preservation of his legacy.

questions.question: Which of the following dances is dedicated to temples and was earlier known as Sadir?
questions.solution: Bharatanatyam was historically performed in the temples of Tamil Nadu by Devadasis and was known as Sadir (or Sadir Attam). It was refashioned and renamed in the early 20th century to gain social respectability and classical status.

questions.question: Dr. Sunanda Nair is recognised as a ___________ performer, teacher, and proponent.
questions.solution: Dr. Sunanda Nair is a globally recognized performer and teacher of Mohiniyattam. She was the first student to earn a Master's degree in Mohiniyattam from Nalanda Nritya Kala Mahavidyalaya (University of Mumbai) under the guidance of Dr. Kanak Rele.

questions.question: Padma Shri awardee Gopal Prasad Dubey was awarded for his contribution to which of the following dances?
questions.solution: Gopal Prasad Dubey is a master of Chhau dance, specifically the Seraikella style. He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2012 for his dedication to preserving and promoting this mask-based semi-classical dance form.

questions.question: Shambhu Maharaj was Awarded the Padma Shri for his contribution to which of the following dances in India?
questions.solution: Shambhu Maharaj was a legendary maestro of the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Kathak. He was the brother of Achhan Maharaj and Lachhu Maharaj, and the uncle of Pandit Birju Maharaj. He received the Padma Shri in 1956.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first woman classical dancer in independent India to be nominated as a member to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale was the first woman in Indian history to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha (in 1952). She is best known for reviving Bharatanatyam from its 'Sadir' roots and founding the Kalakshetra foundation.

questions.question: Haleem Khan is associated with which of the following classical dances?
questions.solution: Haleem Khan is a prominent Kuchipudi dancer known for his mastery over Streevesham (performing female roles). He has broken cultural barriers to excel in this Andhra Pradesh classical tradition.

questions.question: The famous Jhaveri sisters are associated with the _________classical dance form.
questions.solution: The Jhaveri sisters (Nayana, Ranjana, Suverna, and Darshana) are synonymous with Manipuri classical dance. They were students of Guru Bipin Singh and were instrumental in popularizing Manipuri dance outside the state of Manipur.

questions.question: Padma Shri awardee Guru Amubi Singh was conferred the award for his significant contributions in which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Guru Amubi Singh was a towering figure in Manipuri dance and was the first recipient of the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award from the state of Manipur. He received the Padma Shri in 1970 for his contributions as a performer and teacher.

questions.question: Due to the service done by the poet ___________, the Kathakali dance form received a new impetus and today, many innovations are also being made to suit the needs of a changing society.
questions.solution: The great Malayalam poet Vallathol Narayana Menon played a crucial role in the revival of Kathakali. He founded the Kerala Kalamandalam in 1930, which saved the dance form from near-extinction and institutionalized its training.

questions.question: B Herambanathan who was awarded with the ‘Sangeet Natak Akademi Award’ in 2013 is a _________ dancer.
questions.solution: B. Herambanathan is a senior teacher and exponent of the Bharatanatyam tradition, specifically the Thanjavur style. He is noted for maintaining the traditional purity of the dance and was recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2013.

questions.question: Who among the following founded Odissi dance school ‘SRJAN’ in 1993?
questions.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra founded SRJAN in 1993 in Bhubaneswar. He was the first person from Odisha to receive the Padma Vibhushan and is credited with creating the contemporary grammar of Odissi dance.

questions.question: Padma Shri awardee Guru Gangadhar Pradhan is an accomplished dancer of which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Guru Gangadhar Pradhan was an eminent Odissi guru and a brilliant Mardala (percussion) player. He founded the Orissa Dance Academy and the Konark Natya Mandap, contributing immensely to the global outreach of Odissi.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities is associated with the Mohiniattam dance?
questions.solution:
Jayaprabha Menon is a highly acclaimed Mohiniyattam dancer.

Note: Yamini Krishnamurthy is famous for Bharatanatyam/Kuchipudi, Vyjayanthi Kashi for Kuchipudi, and Prerana Shrimali for Kathak.

questions.question: Which is the first of India's traditional dance to be refashioned as a theatre art and to be exhibited widely both at home and abroad?
questions.solution: Bharatanatyam was the first traditional dance to be refashioned as a theatre art. Figures like E. Krishna Iyer and Rukmini Devi Arundale helped transition it from a temple ritual to a professional stage performance enjoyed worldwide.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan awardee Uma Sharma is a ________ dancer.
questions.solution: Uma Sharma is a veteran Kathak dancer who is credited with reviving the old tradition of Nattuvari (dance based on the songs of medieval poets). She founded the Bharatiya Sangeet Sadan in New Delhi.

questions.question: Sonal Mansingh is a prominent Indian classical dancer who specialises in __________.
questions.solution: Sonal Mansingh is a versatile classical dancer who has achieved mastery in both Bharatanatyam and Odissi. She was the youngest recipient of the Padma Bhushan (1992) and later received the Padma Vibhushan (2003).

questions.question: Who among the following personalities is a Padma Vibhushan, legendary Indian Classical Dancer behind reviving the classical dance form of Odissi in the 20th century?
questions.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra is the legendary figure responsible for reviving Odissi in the 20th century. He transformed the ancient temple dance into a structured classical form suitable for modern stages.

questions.question: Which Manipuri Classical Dancer opened the ‘Govindji Nartanalaya’ dance school for women in Imphal?
questions.solution: Guru Bipin Singh, a principal exponent and director of the Manipuri Nartanalaya, opened the Govindji Nartanalaya in Imphal. He is often called the 'Father of modern Manipuri dance'.

questions.question: Who among the following came up with his own style of dance called ‘Hi-dance’, which he later rechristened it and called it 'Creative dance'?
questions.solution: Uday Shankar is known as the 'Father of Modern Dance' in India. He created a unique fusion style called Hi-dance, which he later termed 'Creative Dance', blending Indian classical movements with Western theatrical techniques.

questions.question: Shobana Chandrakumar, a recipient of Padma Shri, is a dancer of which of the following Indian classical dance forms?
questions.solution: Shobana Chandrakumar (known simply as Shobana) is a National Award-winning actress and a highly accomplished Bharatanatyam dancer. She was a disciple of the Chitra Visweswaran and the Vazhuvoor school.

questions.question: Padma Shri awardee Chittani Ramachandra Hegde is known for his contribution to which of the following dance forms in India?
questions.solution: Chittani Ramachandra Hegde was a legendary performer of Yakshagana, the traditional theatre-dance form of Karnataka. He was the first Yakshagana artist to be awarded the Padma Shri.

questions.question: Which ministry launched an All-India dance competition 'Vande Bharatam Nritya Utsav' as part of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav?
questions.solution: The Ministry of Culture launched the Vande Bharatam Nritya Utsav. This national competition was held to select dancers for the Republic Day cultural program as part of the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav celebrations.

questions.question: Who among the following started the Kuchipudi Art Academy at Madras in 1963?
questions.solution: Dr. Vempati Chinna Satyam founded the Kuchipudi Art Academy in Madras (now Chennai) in 1963. He is credited with refining the dance form, introducing new solo items, and giving Kuchipudi a distinct classical identity.
